_meta.status: Dispatch Engine v1. Seeded estimates, not NEMSIS data.
_meta.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: every distribution below is a seeded estimate. Replace with NEMSIS Public-Release Research Dataset distributions when access arrives. Never present these as NEMSIS data.
_meta.samplerRule: The sampler draws age uniform in ageRange, sex by sexSplit, weight uniform in weight_kg. V1 is adult-only (18+): the engine runs adult physiology (80 kg dosing, 5600 mL volume) for every patient, and weight is narrative-only until the engine supports weight-based physiology.
